## fbf36c193fa6

**Reproduced defect — portable task-test path, not generator semantics.** The
selected task-test stage fails 1 of 26 tests because
`tests/test_generator_fbf36c193fa6.py` resolves canonical data relative to the
copied generator directory. In the portable runtime it tries to open
`/tmp/arcpuzzles-check-.../generators/fbf36c193fa6/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`
and raises `FileNotFoundError`. Exact evidence:
`checks/audit/fbf36c193fa6-task_tests/result.json`.

I separately ran lint, self-check, semantic gate, and exact override checks; all
four passed (`checks/audit/fbf36c193fa6-{lint,selfcheck,semantic_gate,override}/`).
The generator declares the strongest known canonical shortcut—red corner-pair
blocking only for upward rays—and schedules downward witnesses; the semantic
gate accepted that contract. I found no additional input-level semantic
counterexample after checking the declared rivals, sliding-window tests, and
those gates. The concrete audit issue is therefore the nonportable test path.
No fix was applied because this was an audit-only target.
